text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before running in the Takarazuka Kinen, 
intending to learn from the girls with 
international experience—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! That's so super hilarious!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inside the waiting room, Vivlos's cheerful 
laughter echoed all around.

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
No, no, this is no laughing matter! It was 
rough back then, you know!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
That's right~ Even though Vivlos-chan was 
thiiis tiny, she was so curious... she'd 
wander off anywhere~.

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
But you know, whenever her two older 
sisters called, she'd come right out. It 
was so cute~♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: So true~! Little me is so cute♡
choice_data_list: (She's able to relax thanks to her family)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, it wasn't lacking tension. Her 
father, an athlete who knew the harshness 
of professional sports, took the lead and 
set the right atmosphere.
choice_data_list: (I'm glad her family was able to come)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today's Takarazuka Kinen brings together 
proven, high-caliber Umamusume, starting 
with Satono Crown and others. Many of them 
likely hail from the Classic Triple Crown 
trail.
choice_data_list:
(Still, if she can just show what she's 
truly capable of—)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: —Hey, Trainie!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, don't you think so too, 
Train-chi?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Kyaa~~â¡ Oh, Trainie, you're too muchâ¡

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... you're surprisingly bold, 
aren't you~?

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
"...Well now, what a pleasant surprise! 
I'd love to have a loooong chat with you 
sometime!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
……Honestly, what good does it do for you 
to be nervous?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'll never, ever forget what you just said 
♡
choice_data_list: (What did I just go and agree to...!?)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Well, let's get ready soon! I got a ton of 
energy from that!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, I... I'm going to win today's 
race.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"I'll definitely live up to everyone's 
cheers!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Nǐ hǎo, Vivlos!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Vivlos-san, I'm looking forward to 
working with you today!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Not at all! I look forward to working 
with you too!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Today, I plan to get lots from the two of 
you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I've heard. You're aiming for Dubai, 
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Running with me would indeed be a valuable 
experience for you. However—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Bitter memories might be what lingers the 
most. Unless you've got the drive to truly 
devour it all.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...No, I won't eat it! I already know.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Giving it your all and having fun can 
teach you so many things!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, I see. So that is your aesthetic.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I will carry out my pride as well. You 
will too, right, Dia?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I haven't had any overseas 
experience yet, but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—I've prepared for this cherished wish of 
mine. More than anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So I'm aiming for it seriously too. With 
Kura-chan's experience, and—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Vivlos-san's passion for her shining 
dreams! I'll use it to fuel my own!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ! A shining dream...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for thinking so big about my 
dream!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
With everyone's sparkles, let's make this 
a super amazing race, okay? ♡
